newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Greystone to get 1.138 Lennar shrs.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Greystone to get 1.138 Lennar shrs.

text.p: Shareholders of Pacific Greystone Corp will receive 1.138 shares of Lennar Corp after a spinoff of its commercial real estate business into a new company, traders said.
They said the company disclosed terms of its previously announced transaction in a conference call.
Lennar declined to discuss terms of the deal.
Traders who specialize in takeover stocks also said Lennar declined to give growth projections for the new company.
They cited the lack of details for a decline in Pacific Greystone's stock.
"The Greystone holders don't know what they're getting," one said.
Shares of Pacific Greystone were down 2-1/4 to 14-7/8. Lennar shares gained 3-1/4 to 29-5/8.
